title: The Windfall
projector_text: A federal tax cut lands today. Every firm in the room gets the same one-time cash. Who gets it?
board_text: Same cash for every firm. Your board has a budget and a menu.

title: The Tool
projector_text: A new AI system can do the work of one in five frontline employees. Every firm has the same offer on the table.
board_text: Same tool for every firm. Your board decides how to use it.

title: The Dry Year
projector_text: A hard year. Revenue is down about 30% in every firm, and each board must cut.
board_text: Revenue is down for every firm. Your board has a savings target and very little to spend.
